scope: Decompose fitted weights in the same nine inner fitting folds, each 128 training objects; no validation/test labels used
parameters: All original: beta=1, Gaussian bandwidth median positive pairwise scaled differences, original common KL normalizer, zeta=.1
measures: Raw KL, support-shrunk KL, normalised W; kernel effective size, support, eta, Jensen-averaging baseline
interpretation: Averaging retention is a descriptive convexity ratio, not a causal bandwidth effect or predictive accuracy metric
